verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a way to view Datadog's own observability spend, attribute it to teams or services, or alert on usage spikes before the bill arrives. The only related item, Cloud Cost Management, appears by title alone and implies cloud-infrastructure cost, not observability spend, so it earns no credit. Community reports of poor billing transparency and surprise bill jumps reinforce that nothing here delivers the story.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can see what my observability spend is, attribute it to teams or services, and catch usage spikes before the bill
